semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides essential measurement and control instruments used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: TOKYO KEISO CO., LTD. specializes in manufacturing flowmeters and level instruments crucial for process control in semiconductor, LCD, and solar cell manufacturing. The company supports the semiconductor industry with its non-contact ultrasonic flowmeters and other measurement equipment, leveraging a global manufacturing and sales network.
capabilities: Measurement equipment for clean room environments
